theorems.name: Submission.lgc_rotated_graph_slope
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (ε : ℝ), 0 ≤ ε → LipschitzWith (Real.toNNReal ε) f → IsClosed (q '' graphOver f univ) ∧ ∀ x ∈ q '' graphOver f univ, ∀ z ∈ q '' graphOver f univ, ‖(x - z) - (rotatedPlane q).starProjection (x - z)‖ ≤ ε * ‖x - z‖
